chapter: Chicago union and the Rhythm Kings
title: Joining the union and going to Chicago with the Rhythm Kings
summary: He has been in the union since 1923; Rappolo invited him to join the New Orleans Rhythm Kings in Chicago.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Oh. You were in the union for years, huh?
Yeah. That's the year I made my appearance, Jay. 1923. I made my debut, yeah.
Yeah, 1923, and it was 1923, 1922 or 1923 when I joined the local in number 10, in how you call it, in Chicago.

I see, you didn't join the union here, but after you went to Chicago, you mean? Yeah, I joined the one in Chicago. Well, that time, that would have put you up with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings then, at that time, in Chicago.
Did you have a hard time getting in the union then?
